name: MLPerf v6.0 Jetson AGX Thor: llama3.1-8b-edge SingleStream TTFT p90 126.5 ms
unit: ms, 90th-percentile first-token latency, per query (SingleStream, concurrency 1)
methodology: MLPerf Inference open-division submission, 1x NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor Developer Kit 128GB (unified memory), TensorRT 10.8, CUDA 12.8. Quoted verbatim from performance/run_1/mlperf_log_summary.txt, Result is VALID. v6.0, llama3.1-8b-edge, FP4 weights, SingleStream, samples_per_query 1, max_async_queries 1. '90.00 percentile first token latency (ns): 126477827' = 126.48 ms. Per request. The 90th-percentile end-to-end query latency on the same log is 1357.55 ms and is not stored.
notes: Open division. Much lower TTFT than the v5.1 submission of the same scenario (1397 ms); the submission does not explain the change, so both are kept.
